pairs.evidence: src/app/api/combat-simulator/route.ts:88 When the caller sends no seed, the combat-simulator route draws a fresh random one, ignoring DEFAULT_CONFIG.seed (42), so re-running the same scenario gives different numbers by default; the standard's 'keep the base constant by default; make re-rolling an explicit action' is inverted, though the seed is echoed back in result.config so a run can be reconstructed afterwards.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/combat-simulator/route.ts:88 Seed is not derived from scenario identity; an omitted seed re-rolls the run with Math.random, which the technique names as the re-roll-until-nice failure.

src/app/api/combat-simulator/route.ts:87 The caller picks the iteration count (1-5000) per request, and the fallback is a literal 1000 rather than a preset's count; a 1-iteration run comes back in the same shape as a full run with no reduced-resolution label.
src/app/api/economy-simulator/goal-seek/route.ts:15 The goal-seek route refuses to solve without a numeric seed, so metric(v) is deterministic; bisection is capped at maxIterations: 40 (line 32).

pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/_shared/data.ts:630 The Kill/Death Statistics panel shows typed constant counts and a hand-assigned dangerRank as though they were measured kill attribution, with no denominator, run count or 'not measured' state; ranged-caster has more player kills (31) than melee-grunt (23) but a lower typed rank (4 vs 3), so the ranking contradicts its own numbers.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/encounters/KillDeathStats.tsx:138 Danger Ranking sorts by a typed rank, not by a kill share taken from an event log; there is no dominance threshold, no diffuse-danger state and no denominator label, and absent measurement is rendered as data.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/encounters/KillDeathStats.tsx:47 Rates and counts are shown with no stated sample basis (no preset, no iteration or run count, no cast version), so 'a rate without its sample size' is rendered throughout.
